features.description: Lions collected in free spins become the top symbol.

features.name: Symbol upgrades
features.description: 4, 7, 13 and 15 lions upgrade other animals to top symbols.

review:
African wildlife on 5x4, where wilds on reels 2 to 4 carry 2x or 3x multipliers that multiply each other in the same win.

Three to five scatters give 8 to 20 free spins with multipliers on every wild and a Special Lion: each lion becomes the top symbol, and collecting 4, 7, 13 and 15 lions upgrades the giraffe, zebra, hyena and meerkat too. Long bonuses get much stronger. Up to 10,000x, 96.5% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
